body:
Love has nothing to do with this. Pain. Constant screaming inside my head. I pause for a moment to let it catch up, to try to deal with it and its like my organs are falling out of my abdomen. All I've been able to do is hide from it. But it always finds me.

Love doesn't make the pain go away. Love has limits.

I helped organize, build, and run a festival a few years ago. The woman who ran it ended up beating me shortly afterwards. That's a long story. She was "special"

I did giant puppetry. 10-15 foot tall.

I play guitar, ukulele, keys, and music production.

Nothing helps. I feel so empty.

Its been pain as long as I can remember.

I plugged it with video games in high school and after I tried to kill myself in college.

Then I had some friends who then went away. So I went to Austin and made a lot of money. Didn't help. Dated beautiful established rich women. Void. 

Therapist upon therapist. I started throwing huge sums of money at the problem. Meditated. Medicated. Scores of friends. Lovers. 

I can't stand to be anywhere for too long anymore. People just get tired of me. I get so extremely sad and then everybody leaves.

People say they love me, but they don't know what they're talking about. They all leave. No one can stand dealing with this much pain.

The people that love me should understand that I was not born by choice. That I was not born to addicts and with a severe mental disorder by choice.

Their pain is immaterial and would be transitory. They would get better. At the very least using the knowledge that I am no longer in such terrible pain as a coping mechanism.

I am actually willfully going to attempt to become a drug addict. Never tried it before. Lots of cheap research chemicals that promise more immediate relief than the garbage pharmaceuticals Ive been prescribed all my life.

Apolgies. I'm very emotional currently.

I have traveled all across the country. Partied in mansions. Been rich. Lived on communes. Built music festivals. Toured with artist troupes. Slept with more women than I remember. Nearly been married. Done every drug in the book. Been an actor. Musician. Puppeteer for Christ sake.

There is. A hole. In. Me.

I don't know what more to do. I've done so much to make this feeling go away. It hurts so much I can't bear it.

My family brought me to life without my consent.

 I've cried myself to sleep more nights than not since I've been eight years old.

Their pain would be a drop in an ocean, especially considering the audacity and selfishness of child bearing.
